keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Topics to find creators for, for example 'budgeting for beginners'. Each one is searched on Google restricted to tiktok.com.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Hashtags to find creators for, with or without the # sign, for example budgeting.

excludeWords.title: Leave out results mentioning
excludeWords.description: Optional. A search result whose title or snippet contains one of these words is dropped (for example course, coach).

searchModifiers.title: Extra search words
searchModifiers.description: Optional words added to every Google query to steer it, for example 'creator'.

maxSearchPages.title: Google result pages per query
maxSearchPages.description: Pages of Google results read for each query wording (about 10 results each).

maxSearchSeconds.title: Search time budget (seconds)
maxSearchSeconds.description: No new Google search is started after this time. Google through the search proxy can take up to a minute per request.

maxCreators.title: Maximum creators returned
maxCreators.description: Hard cap on creators per run (and on profiles looked up).

enrichProfiles.title: Add profile data
enrichProfiles.description: Runs your TikTok Profile and Video Stats Actor in profileOnly mode for the creators found and adds followers, likes, bio, bio link and e-mails. Its compute is billed to your account.

profileActor.title: Profile Actor
profileActor.description: Actor used for the profile data: its ID or username/name. It must accept usernames and mode (profileOnly) and return rows with rowType profile.

minFollowers.title: Minimum followers
minFollowers.description: Optional. Needs 'Add profile data'. Creators below this are marked passesFilters false.

maxFollowers.title: Maximum followers
maxFollowers.description: Optional. Needs 'Add profile data'. Creators above this are marked passesFilters false.

onlyPassing.title: Return only creators inside the follower range
onlyPassing.description: Off returns every creator found with passesFilters true, false or null (null = followers unknown).
